text: The fixed accepted ExchangeFolder captures the requested IDs and headers for the async listener. If fewer IDs are returned, it builds a set and maps successful IDs back to the requested header positions; only that subset is marked read. Its equal-length fast path assumes the returned IDs are the requested IDs, so this is not an independent identity validation for every response. The current Rust operation can notify successful results and also report aggregated failures. This is a scoped source contract; partial-success handling and server responses were not executed. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Current Exchange read updates apply the returned successful IDs
